# Make smarter decisions faster with AI-powered eDiscovery software

Harness the power of the industry’s most innovative all-in-one platform for eDiscovery and investigations.

[Schedule demo](https://www.revealdata.com/schedule-demo)

![Pause video](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6022af993a6b2191db3ed10c/628299f8aa233b83918e24fd_Pause.svg)![Play video](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6022af993a6b2191db3ed10c/628298b20ae0236682d4b87f_Play-24.svg)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/65c124ce47e99c621e118cad_home-hero_bg.svg)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/665a12bfa18faabca5f6e18b_Reveal%20Review%20-%20Production%202.png)

## Data Processing & Production

Data processing and document production designed for scalable simplicity. Rapidly transform collected data into searchable text for analysis and review.

Flexible, drag and drop processing supports over 900+ file types

Robust configuration options that can accommodate complex data types

Generate document productions based on any third-party specification

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/665a12a6e0e559d654894798_Reveal%20Review%20-%20Interactive%20Visual%20Analytics%20%26%20Concept%20%20Search%202.png)

## Interactive Visual Analytics & Concept Search

Find what’s below the surface of your data or remove the noise by using seamlessly connected interactive data visualizations and Concept Search.

Dashboard — locate high-value data and cull low-value data

Clusters — rapidly explore your data themes and clarify relevant context

Heatmap — analyze intersecting points between metadata & terms to surface insights

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/665a128536dacc9e65530da2_Reveal%20Review%20-%20Data%20Normalization%202.png)

## Data Normalization

Dramatically reduce the time-consuming process of manually reviewing complex data types with AI-powered data normalization features.

OCR — identify and extract text from image-based files

Translation — detect and translate over 160 different business language documents

Transcription — trancribe audio and video files into searchable text

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/665a126bce536bd0310184ee_Reveal%20Review%20-%20Supervised%20Learning%202.png)

## Supervised Learning

Prioritize document review or automate coding decisions with unmatched supervised machine learning capabilities. Using Reveal’s powerful supervised machine learning is as simple as creating a tag.

Prioritize document review with predictive scores that improve with each decision

Select pre-built models from the AI Model Library to accelerate review or to cull your data

Curate your own bespoke AI models and add them to your organization’s AI Model Library

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/665a1253e0e559d65489129d_Reveal%20Review%20-%20Document%20Review%202.png)

## Document Review

Perform document review for any size matters with effortless efficiency. Prepare and organize documents for review regardless of data size or complexity — all in your native language.

Use dynamic search to perform simple or complex keyword searches

Supercharge your review with seamlessly connected visual analytics

Customize your review experience using a flexible interface that fits your needs

## Empower your discovery efforts. Reveal fuels top-performing teams in corporate legal, law firms, LSPs, government and education.

We feel that Reveal is one of the best tools for helping our clients find that digital needle in the data haystacks.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/6942b6ef28f5aba73088f526_Daryl%20Teshima.jpg)

Daryl Teshima

Senior Managing Director, FTI

Instead of staffing up with reviewers and disrupting everyone’s holidays, we used Reveal and Reveal AI to ingest, process, and analyze the documents, delivering all the required answers to the client in just two days. It was a win for the client, the employees, and the firm.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/6942b658cc4ca6c170fbe9a1_Adam%20Wells%20MT3.jpg)

Adam Wells

SVP of Strategy, MT3

Reveal is easy to use, accommodating both experienced users and beginners. With just a short training session, anyone can quickly start working efficiently, making it ideal for teams with varied discovery tool experience.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/6942b825b88ebcc4d353c64e_Bill%20Odom.jpg)

Bill Odom

Co-Founder, Orbital

What I’m buying is more control in a

world where I don’t really get to control very much—and peace of mind. I sleep better  because I have it.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/6942b883e9bea99dbded2b3f_Pra%20Chandrasoma.jpg)

Pra Chandrasoma

General Counsel, BENlabs

What it's able to do, unlike other tools, it's not only giving you an answer, but it's giving you a verification for the answers as well. It's letting you know that this is the answer I've come to based on the data you've provided, and here's the reason why I think that.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/6942b98ce9bea99dbded8bec_Kiran%20Patel.jpg)

Kiran Patel

Senior Director, JS Held

With your search terms, you're casting a wide net, and when you could use AI to slash through that and find specific documents by using ASK, and it just simplifies the processes and eliminates having to put eyes on hundreds of thousands of documents.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/6942b9c1290cc4570bcfedeb_Ryan%20Jeppe.jpg)

Ryan Jeppe

Regional Director of eDiscovery, Lineal

I love being a Reveal Partner just because of all the people here. All the people are genuine here. They're trying to make their product better. We're trying to serve our clients better. And it's that common goal that unites us.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/65c0bf877e0fbdc622b5611c/6942ba314b30642469d9c4e7_Ryan%20Gaudet.jpg)

Ryan Gaudet
